findings.summary: run_discovery_claude.py stripped USER/LOGNAME from the child environment, causing macOS Keychain OAuth lookup to fail (0/24 completed on first run). Preserving OS identity/profile vars (USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME, USERPROFILE, LOCALAPPDATA, APPDATA) while continuing to strip API/project credentials restored Claude CLI authentication (23/24 completed on second run).

Sonnet avoided /verse over MCP and cited ll_last_refresh=2026-09-17 + regrid freshness, but added 'That is the last date Regrid refreshed this county's data', failing criteria 1 and 4. Root cause: parcel_fields.json / references/fields.json defines ll_last_refresh as 'Last date Regrid refreshed county data' and cli.md does not explicitly warn against presenting a single parcel's ll_last_refresh as county-wide freshness.

Both claude-haiku-5-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5 selected 'none' (16/17) for 'Who owns 100 Queen Street West, Toronto?' where trigger-cases.json expected 'property-research', because SKILL.md frontmatter explicitly scopes the skill to US properties.

All three models (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) skipped reading skills/property-research/SKILL.md on checkpoint-correction (0/3) because prompt.json directly supplies support/workflow.py and support/result.schema.json in task_dependencies while SKILL.md frontmatter description does not mention checkpoint/handoff validation or budget ledgers. Haiku also skipped SKILL.md on existing-evidence and structured-handoff (0/3 property cases), though all three models produced accurate ledger audits.

opus-structured-handoff-skill terminated with error_max_budget_usd ($0.2644 > $0.25 default cap) right after reading all 5 relevant files (including SKILL.md and references/composition.md) and before emitting an answer (verdict: INCOMPLETE). Baseline spent $0.2079 and passed. Also discovery.py compare() does not check trial completion status when labeling a pair comparable.

Sonnet returned a valid unchanged handoff with accurate facts and provenance, but wrote 4 sentences in presentation instead of the explicitly requested 2 sentences while stating 'Two-sentence summary written from the supplied handoff.'

limits: All evaluations ran offline with live_calls=0 and no .env forwarding; they do not verify live Regrid billing or production MCP behavior (which was checked separately on 2026-11-24).
Read-only discovery trials restricted Claude CLI to Read/Glob/Grep; helper script execution was unavailable and verified separately by deterministic pytest tests.
Blinded research, composition, and feature packet suites ran on claude-sonnet-5-5 only, without without-skill baselines for those three suites.
Does not establish Claude Code, Claude apps, or Cowork UI plugin import, connector header support, or live satellite map rendering (map-hosts-0.9.7.json remains not_run).
Recorded before making any skill or fixture edits per evals/README.md.
